title: Round-3 brand-checked-timers pin never exercises the wrapped clearTimeout seam
detail: The new pin fires step-changed exactly once, so trigger() runs with id === null and t.clear is never called; cancel() (pagehide) is also never fired. A future detached-`clear: env.clearTimeout` regression — half of the original r2-B1 bug — would pass this pin and re-break debouncing on the second step change.
recommended_fix: In the brand-check test, fire EVENT_STEP_CHANGED a second time before runAll() (trigger then clears the pending timer), or fire pagehide with a save pending, so the brand-checking clearTimeout stub is actually invoked.
